description: Source code for LinkingController class managing linking, unlinking, and navigation of items like notes, files, and tags in a web application.

classes.name: LinkingController
classes.description: Controller managing linking, unlinking, and navigation of items such as notes, files, and tags within the web application.

methods.name: get isEntitledToNoteLinking
methods.description: Checks if the user has an active subscription for note linking.

methods.name: setIsLinkingPanelOpen
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of the linking panel.

methods.name: get activeItem
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active item from the application.

methods.name: getFilesLinksForItem
methods.description: Retrieves files linked to or linking to a specific item.

methods.name: getLinkedTagsForItem
methods.description: Retrieves tags linked to a specific item.

methods.name: getLinkedNotesForItem
methods.description: Retrieves notes referencing a specific item.

methods.name: getNotesLinkingToItem
methods.description: Retrieves notes that reference a specific item.

methods.name: activateItem
methods.description: Activates an item, navigating to its view or preview.

methods.name: unlinkItemFromSelectedItem
methods.description: Unlinks a specified item from the currently selected item.

methods.name: ensureActiveItemIsInserted
methods.description: Ensures the active item is inserted, especially if it's a template note.

methods.name: linkItems
methods.description: Links two items together, handling different item types.

methods.name: linkItemToSelectedItem
methods.description: Links the active item to a specified item.

methods.name: createAndAddNewTag
methods.description: Creates a new tag and adds it to the active item.

methods.name: addTagToItem
methods.description: Adds a tag to a note or file.
